Of your own shipments, one is going to Lisbon this week. My records show only the city, not the street, so I can't confirm it's for Rua das Flores.
- NW1002: Standard parcel, currently "Out for delivery", promised by 2026-11-10.

Your other Lisbon parcel, NW1001, was delivered on 2026-11-05, so it isn't part of this week's deliveries.

If your neighbours want updates on their parcels, they can contact us from their own accounts.
